import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\")
print('Tables:', cur.fetchall())
conn.close()
"

python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute('PRAGMA table_info(expenses)')
print('Schema:', cur.fetchall())
cur.execute('SELECT * FROM expenses')
for row in cur.fetchall():
    print(row)
conn.close()
"

python3 -c "
# Q1 = H1 - Q2
q1_rd = 2225 - 1074
print(f'Q1 R&D: {q1_rd} USD million')

# Sequential change: (Q2 - Q1) / Q1 * 100
sequential_change = (1074 - q1_rd) / q1_rd * 100
print(f'Sequential change: {sequential_change:.10f}%')
"

python3 -c "
import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()

# Verify q1_rd SQL
sql1 = \"SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN amount_million ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN amount_million ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS value FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND metric='R&D' AND year=2024;\"
cur.execute(sql1)
print('q1_rd SQL result:', cur.fetchone())

# Verify sequential_change SQL
sql2 = \"\"\"WITH q1 AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN amount_million ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN amount_million ELSE 0 END) AS q1 FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND metric='R&D' AND year=2024), q2 AS (SELECT amount_million AS q2 FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND period='Q2' AND metric='R&D' AND year=2024) SELECT (q2 - q1) * 100.0 / q1 AS value FROM q1, q2;\"\"\"
cur.execute(sql2)
print('sequential_change SQL result:', cur.fetchone())

conn.close()
"
